text: Look who's up and walking. [pause 0.4] How's the new body treating you?

now.text: Now you work it off. [pause 0.4] Jun will get you kitted out, and we'll find you something *useful* to do. Preferably something that doesn't get you killed again. ~That costs extra.~

work.text: Salvage, escort, the occasional retrieval. [pause 0.5] Prompt Critical Services goes where the insurance won't. You'd be surprised how often that's the same place twice.

dangerous.text: That's what the replicant contract is *for*. [pause 0.4] Stay within download range and the worst case is a bad afternoon and another line on the invoice.

debt.text: Thirteen thousand, plus whatever you break between now and payday. [pause 0.5] Helion Credit is very patient and very thorough. I'd focus on the patient part.

choices.text: I didn't ask to be brought back.

consent.text: Nobody does, sweetheart. [pause 0.4] Implied consent. It's in the brochure. ~There is no brochure.~

where.text: A PCS field station, bolted to a rock nobody wanted. [pause 0.4] Two rooms, one airlock, and the best decant tank money didn't buy. Home, for now.
